guidance: three.ws is listed on the Alibaba Cloud International Marketplace (Live per docs/listings.md). Say that and nothing grander: a listing is a product buyers can procure, not an endorsement, certification or tier, and it does not mean the platform runs on Alibaba Cloud (production runs on Google Cloud). The Qwen work is real but narrow: the @three-ws/alibaba-cloud-mcp package is community-built, NOT affiliated with Alibaba Cloud, and calls DashScope with the user's own key on the user's machine; never call it official. In the brain compare film the Qwen column is Qwen 3.8 27B on open lanes, so never claim that column ran on Alibaba Cloud or DashScope; the DashScope Qwen Plus lane exists in the router but needs sign-in. Qwen and ModelScope as an agent brain through the listing, one-click deploy from the Alibaba Cloud console and the enterprise launchpad are announced next steps, not shipped: never present them as live. Do not use the blog's rank, reach or first claims. Keep every claim to the listing, the MCP tools and the router, each tied to a fact.

features.title: Qwen as MCP tools: chat and embeddings through DashScope
features.summary: The @three-ws/alibaba-cloud-mcp package gives any MCP client three tools that call Alibaba Cloud Qwen models through DashScope: qwen_chat for written answers, qwen_embed for vectors and qwen_list_models. It runs as a stdio server on your own machine with your own DashScope key, and every tool has a page on three.ws with its arguments and a paste-ready client config. The package is community-built and not affiliated with Alibaba Cloud.

features.title: The Brain lab: one prompt streamed to every model, Qwen included
features.summary: The Brain lab sends one prompt to many models at once and streams the answers side by side with live speed and token counts, so you can pick an agent's brain on evidence. Qwen sits in the same roster as Claude, GPT and the rest: the router carries a DashScope lane for Qwen Plus and a ModelScope lane for Qwen3-Coder, and the film shows the open Qwen 3.8 27B lane answering next to the others.

features.title: three.ws on the Alibaba Cloud International Marketplace
features.summary: three.ws is live on the Alibaba Cloud International Marketplace, so buyers can procure the <agent-3d> stack, a single HTML tag that deploys a 3D AI agent, through their existing cloud account. Each agent is a transferable on-chain asset with a browser-native 3D body, a swappable LLM brain and x402 payments settling in USDC on Solana. The listing, the storefront and an Alibaba Cloud Marketplace editorial feature are all published.
